entity_raw.definition_raw: Truth SubdomainSource Divine Anthology pg. 27This subdomain requires the Acolyte of Apocrypha trait to access.Associated Domain(s): MadnessAssociated Deities: Groetus, Lamashtu, Sifkesh, SivanahReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the aura of madness power of the Madness domain. Dawning Realization (Su): At 8th level, you can impart a shared vision of unfathomable ineffability to a living creature you touch as a standard action, after which your turn immediately ends. You are dazed and the target confused for 1 round by what you both learn. On the following round, you are both staggered for 1 round by the ramifications of your discovery. On the third round, you are confused and the target dazed for 1 round as you attempt to regain your bearings. Each round, the target can attempt a Will save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier to negate that round’s effects for both of you, though the effect does not end until the end of the third round. This is a mindaffecting effect that you can use a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your class level. Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd—wall of nausea, 5th—contact other plane, 6th—litany of madness.
